closes: R3-02 (P2 research resource and approval client entry paths)

client_path.reason: C's MCP Bridge only calls tools registered on the DSH MCP server; a server-side data interface is not reachable from RPH. The extension keeps one controlled path instead of adding a second client protocol.
client_path.p1_contract_preserved: the eight frozen P1 tools (acp_capabilities, acp_preflight, acp_submit, acp_status, acp_cancel, acp_prepare_artifact, acp_read_artifact, acp_analyze) remain the P1 allowlist and never change names or schemas
client_path.extension_rule: P2 tools are advertised only when the client negotiates the extension capability in the MCP initialize params; a client that did not negotiate receives unsupported_capability and sees only the P1 allowlist
client_path.rejected_alternative: restricted HTTP client path - not chosen in Plan B; adding one would create a second client contract to keep in sync
forbidden: a model-supplied approver, tenant or role
a second task state machine for research records

tool_naming.version_rule: the tool name carries the major version suffix; a breaking change publishes a new tool name and keeps the old one for one frozen stage
tool_naming.authorization_rule: the server resolves principal, project and permission for every tool call; payload identity claims are ignored or rejected

controller_client.rule: the ControllerClient is the only transport for these tools; it calls the application commands, never the manager, the store or a thread

waits.rule: waiting is a bounded query plus an authoritative snapshot, never an unbounded long poll and never a chat-session timer

rows.application_use_case: Data typed resource: acp_services.data.operations.ProposalResourceService.{create,read,update_cas} over the published manifest/resource boundary
rows.authorization: scope read for read, scope write for create/update; project and principal resolved server-side; CAS requires expected_revision and returns conflict on mismatch
rows.idempotency: create/update accept idempotency_key; the same key with a different proposal_digest is conflict (revision_conflict, params.rule=idempotency_key_reuse)
rows.live_tool_requirement: visible in tools/list after acp.research.v1 negotiation and callable through tools/call; a Data interface alone is not a live DSH tool
rows.evidence_gate: headless RPH creates a proposal, reads it back, CAS-updates it once, and observes conflict on a stale revision

rows.application_use_case: acp_services.runtime.approval.ApprovalService.{request,query} (B16); request binds plan_digest, never a mutable plan
rows.authorization: request: scope write as the resolved requesting principal; query: scope read on the resolved project. A client can request and query but can never approve through these tools.
rows.idempotency: one pending approval per (proposal_ref, plan_digest); a second request with the same pair returns the existing approval_ref (replayed=true), a different plan_digest is conflict
rows.live_tool_requirement: visible only after extension negotiation; approving requires a different tool and a verified human principal
rows.evidence_gate: a headless client requests and queries an approval; a second request for the same plan_digest is replayed, not duplicated

rows.application_use_case: acp_services.runtime.approval.ApprovalService.{approve,reject,revoke} (B16), bound to the frozen plan_digest; the persistence is B16's approval store, not a second authority
rows.authorization: approver identity MUST come from the authenticated Controller channel (token/session principal) and MUST hold the approval permission. A payload field naming an approver, role or tenant is refused with authorization (access_denied, params.rule=approver_identity_from_payload). A model cannot substitute itself for the human approver.
rows.idempotency: a repeated decision with the same expected_revision and the same outcome is replayed; a different outcome on a decided approval is conflict
rows.live_tool_requirement: advertised only to authorized clients; the decision tool is never offered to an unauthenticated client
rows.evidence_gate: approve/reject/revoke each move revision exactly once; a payload-claimed approver is denied; a revoked approval cannot authorize a submit

rows.application_use_case: Runtime bounded query: acp_services.runtime.projections + events cursor over the authoritative task/approval/budget facts
rows.authorization: scope read on the resolved project; the cursor is bound to the principal and cannot be replayed across principals
rows.idempotency: wait/snapshot are read-only; replaying a cursor returns the same event window and never mutates state
rows.live_tool_requirement: bounded by max_wait_s<=60 and limit<=200; an unbounded wait is invalid-parameter
rows.evidence_gate: disconnect the client mid-wait, reconnect with the cursor, and observe the same authoritative snapshot_revision

rows.authority: C research semantics + B resource facts
rows.application_use_case: recover command over B resource facts; C supplies the research semantics of what is resumable
rows.authorization: scope write plus a valid unrevoked approval bound to plan_digest; a chat session is never authority for task facts
rows.idempotency: resume is idempotent per (proposal_ref, plan_digest, task_ref); a mismatched plan_digest forces full recompute rather than adoption
rows.live_tool_requirement: resume never creates a second attempt for an existing valid one and never adopts a partial/diagnostic result as normal
rows.evidence_gate: terminate the DSH session, resume in a new session, and observe the same resource revision and task reference

approval_lifecycle.note: draft is the pre-request state; the wire status for a requested but undecided approval is pending (frozen C01/B03 status enum).
approval_lifecycle.separate_from_execution: approval state never changes a JobStatus; resume() remains review-only

binding_ownership.rule: the binding owner ships the live tool, the ControllerClient method and the application use case together; a Data interface delivered without a live tool is not closure of R3-02

p1_allowlist_unchanged.rule: these eight names and their input schemas are the frozen P1 contract; the P2 extension adds names instead of widening them
